letter.subject: Intern Drafter, Macquarie Park
paragraphs: I am applying for the Intern Drafter role at Menard Oceania advertised on SEEK. Supporting your senior drafters and design engineers on civil, structural and geotechnical drawings, with mentoring from the Design Manager, is the kind of start I am looking for.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design. I designed and documented road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, and prepared and reviewed technical drawings in AutoCAD and Civil 3D using Australian Standards. I also modelled a footing and column in 3D in AutoCAD and a pedestrian truss bridge in Revit. This is coursework rather than commercial drafting, and ground improvement drawings would be new to me.

Before moving to Australia I completed a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering and worked on site in the Philippines from 2019 to 2020 as a project-in-charge engineer and field engineer. I reviewed structural and architectural drawings against project requirements, carried out inspections and quality checks, and kept site reports and material records, so I care about drawings that are accurate and buildable.

I have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence, and am open to discussing relocation to Sydney for the right role. I would value the chance to talk. I've attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
